import os, subprocess, socket

print("Candidate contract files at the requested path:")
for p in ["docs/explanation/agent-workflow.md", "docs/explanation", "docs"]:
    print(f"  {p}: exists={os.path.exists(p)}")

print("\nSearch for any file literally named agent-workflow.md:")
found = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("/", topdown=True):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in {"proc","sys","dev","run","usr","lib","lib64","bin","sbin","etc","var","opt","boot","snap","proc"}]
    if "agent-workflow" in files or any("agent-workflow" in f for f in files):
        found.append(root)
print(" ", found or "(none found anywhere on the filesystem)")

print("\nListening TCP sockets (is any local service even up?):")
try:
    out = subprocess.run(["ss","-ltn"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10).stdout
    print(out or "(ss produced no output)")
except Exception as e:
    print("ss unavailable:", e)

print("\nSanity check: try connecting to the previously-seen kernel control port 37483")
s = socket.socket(); s.settimeout(1)
try:
    s.connect(("127.0.0.1", 37483)); print("  connected -> that's the Jupyter kernel, not a service")
except Exception as e:
    print("  not reachable:", e)
finally:
    s.close()
